rules: A cell is present, absent or unknown with a source: a repo, a pinned commit, a file path or a doc anchor. No numeric score appears for anything scripts/benchmark.mjs did not run.
Dotfield cells that name a probe are filled by the script from lib/bench/probes.mjs at render time; a probe that reads not_implemented prints absent.

Competitor cells are self-assessed from each project's repository or documentation; no competitor was executed. Phase 2 adapters (d2, mmdc, elkjs) are not present; when they are installed the script prints not run until a local adapter exists.
